headline: A 2016 law renamed a Stockton, California post office after the late W. Ronald Coale.
what_it_does: This law gives a specific Postal Service facility at 1048 West Robinhood Drive in Stockton, California, a new official name: the "W. Ronald Coale Memorial Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on June 13, 2016.
